# A clump of reeds with three cattails: flat two-sided blades (0.1 m wide cards) leaning out. Up Z.
new
add mesh cube --name B0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0.55
scale 0.11 0.03 1.1
apply --scale
set rotation 0 10 0
add mesh cube --name B1 --size 1 --location 0.18 0.08 0.45
scale 0.11 0.03 0.9
apply --scale
set rotation 0 -14 25
add mesh cube --name B2 --size 1 --location -0.17 0.05 0.5
scale 0.11 0.03 1.0
apply --scale
set rotation 0 16 -30
add mesh cube --name B3 --size 1 --location 0.05 -0.15 0.4
scale 0.11 0.03 0.8
apply --scale
set rotation -12 0 70
add mesh cube --name B4 --size 1 --location -0.08 0.16 0.6
scale 0.11 0.03 1.2
apply --scale
set rotation 10 0 100
material new Reed --base-color 0.220 0.718 0.392
select B0 B1 B2 B3 B4
material assign Reed
add mesh cylinder --name T0 --vertices 6 --radius 0.07 --depth 0.26 --location 0.02 0.02 1.25
add mesh cylinder --name T1 --vertices 6 --radius 0.065 --depth 0.24 --location 0.3 0.1 1.0
add mesh cylinder --name T2 --vertices 6 --radius 0.065 --depth 0.24 --location -0.3 0.1 1.05
material new Cattail --base-color 0.365 0.153 0.365
select T0 T1 T2
material assign Cattail
select all
shade flat
export reeds.glb
